original: 天下皆**知**美之为美，斯恶已；皆**知**善之为善，斯不善已。
vernacular_zh: 人都知道美之为美，丑的观念就产生了；都知道善之为善，不善的观念就产生了。
translation_en: All in the world know the beauty of the beautiful, and in doing this they have (the idea of) what ugliness is; they all know the skill of the skilful, and in doing this they have (the idea of) what the want of skill is.

scripture.text_zh: 律法本是外添的，叫过犯显多；只是罪在哪里显多，恩典就更显多了。
scripture.text_en: Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound.

insight_zh: 老子：**知善**，而生不善；保罗：**知罪**，而生过犯。
insight_en: Laozi: **knowing good**, the not-good arises. Paul: **knowing sin**, the offence abounds.
